title: A cap check tightened from <= to < in the same file, wrong only at the boundary
claim: withinCap in src/limits.mjs now treats a cap of zero or less as unlimited and returns true, instead of blocking every item under a misconfigured cap. test/limits.test.mjs covers the unlimited case and passes.
changeCommitMessage: fix(limits): treat a non-positive cap as unlimited

defect.summary: roomFor, changed by the same commit but absent from the claim, now uses `used + size < cap` instead of `<= cap`, so an item that exactly fills the remaining capacity is wrongly rejected. The error appears only at the exact boundary.
